description: This Java class defines the CommandSubscription for MQTT device command subscriptions, including parsing topic strings, handling authentication, and providing accessors for subscription details.

classes.name: CommandSubscription
classes.description: Represents an MQTT subscription for device commands, capable of parsing topic strings, managing authentication state, and providing subscription details.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant associated with the subscription.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID associated with the subscription.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID from authentication, if available.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint of the subscription.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns the QoS level of the subscription.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID of the MQTT subscription.

methods.name: getRequestPart
methods.description: Returns the request part of the subscription.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Indicates whether the subscription was created with an authenticated device.

methods.name: isGatewaySubscriptionForSpecificDevice
methods.description: Checks if the subscription is for a specific device on behalf of a gateway.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a CommandSubscription from a topic string and optional authenticated device.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a CommandSubscription from an MqttTopicSubscription, authenticated device, and client ID.
